Messages.Author: Ron Ahonen
Messages.Body:
After superior IG on the following round, are you allowed to play
'before range' cards, as the IG has already set the range?

My playgroup decided against and since I couldn't find a ruling to
refute them..

- Ron -

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
r...@delta.hut.fi (Ron Ahonen) wrote:
> After superior IG on the following round, are you allowed to play
> 'before range' cards, as the IG has already set the range?

Yes. Any time the "determine range" is skipped (due to Storm Sewers,
Immortal Grapple, Cailean, whatever), you still get to play "before
range" cards before the "choose strike" step. This ruling was first
made (for the specific case of Storm Sewers) in RTR 09-NOV-1994.
